audience: developers who manage feature flags with Hypertune

useCases.title: List the feature flags of a project
useCases.text: The AI lists the top-level flags with their return types and descriptions. It helps you see what exists before you test anything.

useCases.title: Check what a flag returns for a given user
useCases.text: The AI evaluates one or more flags for a context you give, such as environment and user attributes. You get the resolved values.

useCases.title: Inspect the rules behind a flag
useCases.text: The AI fetches the unreduced logic of a flag, with its conditional expression and rules instead of one value. It explains how the flag is set up.

useCases.title: Compare a flag for a UK and a US user
useCases.text: The AI evaluates the same flag for several contexts, such as a UK user and a US user, and shows the differences.

useCases.title: Run a custom query for a special flag shape
useCases.text: The AI runs your own GraphQL query with variables against the Hypertune endpoint. Use it for nested selections that the other tools cannot express.
